text:
cara (People Ops): idea: run a 'Kudos Sticker Booth' during the spring social. people can pick 3 stickers and leave a 1-line kudos on a board. low-cost, immediate recognition. thoughts?

dave (Events): love it. interactive and photo-friendly. we can brand a small backdrop and add a polaroid camera for quick snaps.

nora (Office Ops): logistics: booth table + 3 shelving risers + 300 sticker packs (each pack = 6 stickers) should do. need a volunteer rota for 2-hour shifts.

li (Vendor): quick vendor recs: stickermule.com for custom sheets (5-7 day lead) or local printshop for rush. approx cost: $0.80/pack for 300 packs, tooling $30.

sam (People Ops Intern): I can mock a sticker sheet concept: icons for Collaboration, Hustle, Kindness, Curious, Problem Solver, Extra Mile. will post mock by EOD.

cara (People Ops): budget ask: $350 (stickers + backdrop + camera film + misc). approve from culture budget?

reminder-bot: note scheduled  finalize art and PO by 1990014000.

nora (Office Ops): distribution note: we'll do booth at main atrium 11-2 on the day. post-event leftover packs go into a 'kudos drawer' for managers.

dave (Events): add a digital form QR next to the board for remote folks to submit kudos; we'll project a live feed of entries.

li (Vendor): PO draft:
```
vendor: stickermule.com
item: custom sticker packs (6 stickers per pack)
qty: 300 packs
unit_price: $0.80
tooling: $30
lead_time: 5 business days
```

cara (People Ops): approved. sam share art by 1990013000, li submit PO once art is final. I'll post the volunteer signup and announcement. excited! :tada:
